title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Conscientiously Studying, Publicizing and Implementing the Revised Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: I. People's Courts at all levels shall earnestly organize the vast number of adjudicators to study the revised Criminal Law. The revised Criminal Law conscientiously summarizes the practical experience of implementing the Criminal Law over the past 17 years, draws on domestic and foreign legislative experience concerning criminal law, and clearly stipulates the basic principles of the Criminal Law; it highlights the protection of the socialist market economy order; it adapts to the practical needs of combating criminal acts, and provides more explicit and detailed provisions for some common and frequently occurring crimes that have drawn strong reactions from the people; it stipulates corresponding criminal liability for newly emerging criminal acts that require punishment; it modifies and improves some important criminal law systems, making it a more scientific, unified, and complete criminal code. People's Courts at all levels shall formulate study plans, adopt various forms, continuously deepen their study, and truly understand and master it.

II. People's Courts at all levels shall, in light of local actual conditions and in coordination with relevant departments, extensively and deeply conduct publicity activities on the revised Criminal Law. The revised Criminal Law is a powerful weapon for judicial organs to combat and punish crimes, and will have a significant impact on many aspects of social, political, and economic life. People's Courts shall give full play to the advantages of adjudication work, through various forms such as news media, highlight key points, and carry out targeted publicity work on the revised Criminal Law.

III. After the revised Criminal Law comes into effect, People's Courts at all levels must resolutely implement and enforce it. For acts occurring before the implementation of the revised Criminal Law, where cases have not yet been handled or are being handled after October 1, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 12 of the revised Criminal Law; for cases that have been finally adjudicated by the People's Court before the implementation of the revised Criminal Law, if after implementation the People's Court re-trials them under the trial supervision procedure, the relevant legal provisions at the time of the original final adjudication shall apply.

IV. Before the implementation of the revised Criminal Law, People's Courts shall still adjudicate criminal cases in accordance with the current Criminal Law and the relevant decisions and supplementary provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on amending and supplementing the Criminal Law, as well as the relevant judicial interpretations of the Supreme People's Court, and shall comply with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law concerning procedures and time limits.

V. After the implementation of the revised Criminal Law, for the decisions and supplementary provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress that have been explicitly abolished, the relevant judicial interpretations previously made by the Supreme People's Court shall no longer apply. However, if the substantive content of the relevant articles of the revised Criminal Law has not changed, the People's Court may, in criminal adjudication work, refer to them for enforcement before new judicial interpretations are issued. Other judicial interpretations that conflict with the provisions of the revised Criminal Law shall no longer apply.

VI. In the process of studying, publicizing, and implementing the revised Criminal Law, People's Courts at all levels shall strengthen investigation and research, pay attention to collecting major and difficult issues concerning the understanding and application of the law that are encountered, and promptly report them.
This is hereby notified.
